quote: Text-to-image (T2I) models consist of two main components: a text encoder, which generates representations of the user's prompt, and a diffusion model, which generates an image based on this representation.

To evaluate the generated images, we employ two key metrics: CLIP score, which measures how well the generated images align with the textual prompt, and KID (Kernel Inception Distance), to evaluate the quality of generated images.
